items.q: Why did a boy with a heart condition end up becoming a devil hunter in the first place - what is the chain from his father's death and the Yakuza debt, to meeting a wounded dog at a grave, to waking up as a hybrid?
What exactly happened the night the Yakuza and the Zombie Devil ambushed Denji at the abandoned factory, and what did Pochita sacrifice to pull him back as the Chainsaw Man?
Why did Denji strike a deal with Power before facing the Bat Devil, what did the Bat Devil actually do to Meowy and to Power, and how did the Bat Devil's leech girlfriend turn the rescue into a trap?
Why did Makima recruit Power into the division, and how did the Division 4 household change after Power moved in with Denji and Aki?
How does the Eternity Devil's trap actually work - the endless eighth floor, the feeding on fear, the growing with every kill - and why was Denji's willingness to be eaten the only way out?
How did Himeno keep going after losing five partners in a row, and what changed in her the day Aki sat down next to her in a graveyard?
What exactly happened in Himeno's last fight with the Katana Man, and why did she give all of herself to the Ghost Devil when she had nothing left?
What happened to Aki's family on the day the Gun Devil came to Japan, and how did one afternoon turn him into a devil hunter with a single, unchanging goal?
Why did Aki keep hunting a devil that had already been killed long ago and split between the world's powers, and what did the Future Devil's vision cost him to know?

What was the real plan behind the Katana Man's attack - the shooting, the thirty life-sentence convicts, the shrine - and why did the Katana Man believe Denji was responsible for his grandfather's death?
Why did Makima take Denji on that movie-marathon date, and what was she hiding from him while he thought he was finally getting close to her?

What did Denji learn about his own heart while he spent time with Reze - the flower, the school, the swimming lesson - and why did a serial killer working with the Typhoon Devil choose her as bait for Denji?

How did the girl who introduced herself as a cafe worker come to carry part of the Bomb Devil inside her - the Soviet super-soldier program - and what happened when Denji found out who she really was?
What did the Angel Devil lose in that coastal village, and why did Makima make him forget it before hiring him into Public Safety?

What exactly did each of the international assassins want - the American brothers, the Russian hunter, the Chinese fiend team, Santa Claus - and why did the entire world turn on one boy at the same time?
Why did Makima make Denji her dog, and what was the door Pochita had warned him never to open?
What exactly happened in the moment Makima killed Power, and how was that the first step of the trap she had been setting all along?
How did Kishibe's Anti-Makima Squad take down a woman whose injuries were transferred to every Japanese citizen, and why was summoning the Hell Devil their only real option?
What happened between Pochita, the Four Horsemen and the Weapon Devils in Hell, and why did the Horsemen arrive on Earth and go their separate ways?
What did the Gun Devil arc actually reveal - that Aki's lifelong target had been dead for years, its flesh divided among the great powers - and how did that change what his fight was really about?
Why did the Angel Devil turn on Makima at the beach, what did he suddenly remember, and how did that memory end Aki's story?
What did Pochita do to the World War II, Nazi and Nuclear Weapons Devils in Hell, and why did it cost the War Devil the last of her strength?
What happened to Power after the Control Devil arc, and what promise kept Denji looking for her even though the two would be complete strangers if they met again?
Why did the War Devil fix her attention on a classroom where a chicken devil was the class pet, and what happened the day Bucky was crushed?
What is the War Devil's actual plan for Asa's body, and how do Asa's trauma and Yoru's guilt keep trading control of the same body back and forth?
What happened to Asa at the riverbank, in the orphanage, and with Crambon, and why do those specific memories hand control of her body back from Yoru to her?
Why did the class president make a contract with the Justice Devil, and what exactly did the devil order her to do?
What exactly did the Falling Devil do to Asa's apartment complex, and how did Yoru keep Asa from becoming one of the bodies stacked in the street?
Why did Yoshida order Asa to cut off contact with Denji, and what do the two of them share that she doesn't know yet?
What happened on Asa and Denji's aquarium date - the Famine Devil's trap, the starfish, the million yen - and how did a spear made from guilt defeat the Eternity Devil in a single blow?
Why did Fami build a church around a hero that she wasn't, and why did she want both Asa and Yoru working on the inside?
How did Haruka Iseumi found the Chainsaw Man Church, and why did the public start mistaking Asa's deeds for Denji's?
Who are the Weapons, why do they call themselves that, and what did they propose for bringing the Chainsaw Man back to the fight?
Why did Denji defy Public Safety and end up dismembered at the Tokyo Devil Detention Center, and how did Asa's group put him back together without knowing who he was?
What did Barem Bridge do to Nayuta, and why was Denji at his breaking point the moment he saw her head?
What deal did Public Safety make with the Aging Devil - ten thousand youths in exchange for Pochita devouring them - and what did Pochita erase to make Denji remember why he stayed alive?
Why did both Asa and Yoru end up caring about Denji, and what did Yoru mean when she said that both of them liked him?
What exactly happened when the Death Devil revealed herself behind Fami's alias, and how did the fight with Yoru end - the pawns, the surrender?
Why does the Death Devil still go to karaoke with her friends as a high schooler, and what happened when Yoru threatened the friends she was holding hostage?
How did the War Devil arc end - Pochita eating himself to make a world where the Chainsaw Man never existed - and what state was Denji left in?
How did Asa and Yoru come to be separated, and what does Asa's life look like in the final chapter - a normal high schooler with Bucky at her side?
Why did Yoru come to Earth to hunt the Chainsaw Man, and what had happened to her body in the battle in Hell that left her at the edge of being forgotten?
What is Nayuta now - the Control Devil reincarnated as Denji's little sister - and why does she end up ordering Denji and Power around at the end of the series?
What happened to Fumiko at fourteen when she made her contract with the STD Devil, and how did the Gun Fiend battle take her parents away from her?
Why did Kishibe keep chasing after Quanxi for nine years, and how did the assassin who would have won a bare-knuckle tournament end up beheaded at the Detention Center?

Why did the Four Horsemen scatter across Earth - Control ruling as Makima, War hiding in Asa's body, Famine posing as a classmate, Death working under Fami's alias - and what did each of them actually want?
Why did the Chainsaw Man Church marry off its young members and turn them into weapons, and what did Denji's refusal say to them?
How did Kobeni go from a terrified girl who tripped over her ice cream to a devil hunter who survived the Eternity Devil, and what had changed in her by the time of the Control Devil arc?
What is the Loneliness Fiend, how does his crossbow actually work, and why was Aki the only one it had no effect on?

Trace Denji's own state from the boy with the heart disease to the end of the Public Safety Saga - what he started out wanting, what he was made to want, and how each devil he fought changed what he was fighting for.
